blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Raw image intensities are a poor surrogate for similarity across images in correspondence problems. Further, while auxiliary segmentation labels can provide semantic identification and improve matching, they can assign only coarse identities to fine-grained anatomy and often cover only a subset of structures, particularly in whole-body settings. We present an approach that instead establishes correspondence using complementary representations of anatomy and demonstrate its utility for longitudinal whole-body PET/CT registration in the Learn2Reg 2026 PSMAReg Challenge. Our 3D foundation model, anatomix, is used to derive fine-grained, per-voxel semantic representations that are consistent across volumes, and we further employ off-the-shelf segmentation models to obtain coarse anatomical identities. Together, these representations drive a GPU-accelerated iterative registration solver (FireANTs) in a hybrid multistage framework: the first stage estimates alignment from dense multi-channel features, after which a second refines the deformation using both anatomix- and segmentation-based losses. Lastly, because registration should not introduce non-biological tumor volume changes across time, we develop lesion-specific component-wise volume preservation schemes. Without any task-specific training, our system won first place in the PSMAReg Challenge leaderboard. Code and interactive visualizations are available at http://www.neeldey.com/reps-for-reg.
blocks.zh: 原始图像强度(Raw image intentity)是通信问题中图像之间相似性的劣质代词. 此外,虽然辅助分解标签可以提供语义识别并改进匹配,但它们只能将粗糙的特征指定给精细的解剖学,而且往往只覆盖一子集的结构,特别是在全身设置中. 我们提出了一种办法,即利用解剖学的补充表述来建立通信,并展示其在 " 学习2Reg 2026 PSMAREG挑战 " 中纵向全身PET/CT注册的效用。 我们的3D基础模型-Anatomix,被用于得出精细的,每伏克索尔语义表达式,在数量上是一致的,我们进一步使用现成的分解模型来获得粗糙的解剖特征. 这些表示式共同驱动了混合多相架构中GPU加速迭代登记解析器(FireANTs):第一阶段估计从密集多相道特征来进行对齐,之后的第二阶段则同时利用解剖-和分解-损失来完善变形. 最后,由于登记不应引入非生物肿瘤的体积随时间变化,我们制定了针对不同部分的损伤量保全计划。 没有任何任务特定训练,我们的系统在PSMAREG挑战排行榜上获得了第一名. 代码和交互式可视化可在http://www.neeldey.com/reps-for-reg上查阅。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
The medical image registration literature’s focus has largely shifted from optimization methods [ 2 ] toward learned models that directly predict deformation fields [ 4 ] quickly and accurately within domain. When trained on diverse data, these models can further act as generalist networks that operate across imaging contexts [ 9 , 23 ] . However, such generalists still underperform task-specific networks, necessitating training new models for every dataset, modality, or application for optimal performance. Fast registration solvers [ 10 , 12 , 20 ] are attractive in this regard because their transformation models, objectives, and regularizers can be adapted directly to the problem at hand without requiring task-specific training [ 11 ] .
We show that these solvers are not intrinsically limited by their optimization methods, but by the representation used to establish correspondence.
blocks.zh:
医疗图像注册文献的焦点主要从优化方法[2]转向直接预测域内变形场[4]的学习模型. 这些模型在接受关于各种数据的培训时,可进一步发挥跨成像背景[9、23]的泛泛论网络的作用。 然而,这些通论者仍然未能很好地执行特定任务的网络,需要为每个数据集、模式或应用培训新的模型,以达到最佳性能。 在这方面,快速登记解决者[10、12、20]具有吸引力,因为他们的转换模式、目标和规范器可以直接适应手头的问题,而不需要具体任务的培训[11]。
我们显示,这些解答者并不受其优化方法的内在限制,而是受到用来建立函证的表示的限制.

blocks.en: We therefore approach registration as a representation problem. Instead of relying solely on image intensities or labels, we show that better registration can be achieved by matching features extracted from a generalist foundation model. We use anatomix [ 5 ] , a 3D biomedical foundation model pretrained on abundant, highly variable synthetic data to extract semantically meaningful voxelwise representations across imaging modalities, anatomical regions, and downstream tasks. These features are approximately invariant to nuisance appearance variation while remaining equivariant to spatial transformations, making them naturally suited for establishing correspondence between volumes. Further, rather than relying on any single similarity signal, we combine complementary, domain-specific representations to improve longitudinal PSMA PET/CT registration for the PSMAReg challenge. We augment anatomix with MIND-SSC [ 8 ] , a handcrafted descriptor based on local self-similarity, alongside anatomical and lesion segmentations to provide coarse semantic identities for individual structures. For PSMAReg specifically, we further develop a region-based matching objective for poorly overlapping organs and lesion-aware volume-preserving constraints to prevent registration from altering quantitative PET biomarkers. This combination retains the flexibility of task-specific optimization with high-quality registration solvers (like FireANTs [ 10 ] ) while obtaining its correspondence signal from general-purpose pretrained representations, all without any training or finetuning on the challenge’s training dataset. Our code is available at https://github.com/neel-dey/reps-for-reg/ .
blocks.zh: 因此,我们把登记视为一个代表性问题。 我们不只依靠图像强度或标签,而是表明可以通过匹配从泛论基础模型中提取的特征来实现更好的注册. 我们使用解剖学 [5],一个3D生物医学基础模型 预先在丰富的,高度多变的合成数据上 提取成像方式,解剖区域, 和下游任务中 具有成像意义 的 voxelwise 表达。 这些特征大致不常用于扰动外观变异,而与空间变异保持等效,因此自然适合在卷间形成对应. 此外,我们不依靠任何单一的相似性信号,而是将互补的、针对具体领域的表述结合起来,以改进PSMA PET/CT对PSMAREG挑战的纵向登记。 我们用 MIND-SSC [8] 来增加解剖学,这是一个基于当地自我同质性的手工描述,与解剖学和损伤分解一起,为单个结构提供粗糙的语义特征。 具体地说,对于PSMAReg,我们进一步发展了一个基于区域的匹配目标,用于处理器官重叠程度低和体积受损害的保全限制,以防止登记改变定量PET生物标记。 这种组合保留了与高质量的登记解决者(如FireANTs[10])进行具体任务优化的灵活性,同时从一般用途预先培训的表述中获得其通信信号,而所有这一切都没有就挑战的培训数据集进行任何培训或微调。 我们的代码可见于https://github.com/neel-dey/reps-for-reg/. 。 。 。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Given a pair of PET/CT volumes to register ( a ), we extract both fine-grained representations with the learned anatomix foundation model [ 5 ] and the hand-crafted MIND-SSC descriptor [ 8 ] and coarse-grained representations as in PSMA lesion and anatomical segmentation maps, obtained using LION [ 19 ] and TotalSegmentator [ 25 ] , respectively ( b ). Using these complementary representations, we design a hybrid multi-stage registration framework that uses a fast registration solver (FireANTs) to align the representations ( c ). Most residual misalignment after stage-1 is in small abdominal organs and are rectified after stage-2 ( d ).
blocks.zh: 图1:鉴于需要注册的一对PET/CT卷(a),我们从人工制作的MIND-SSC描述符[5]和粗细描述符中提取了精细描述符,如PSMA损伤图和解剖分解图,分别使用LION[19]和TotalSectionator[25]获得(b)。 利用这些互补表述,我们设计了一个混合的多阶段登记框架,使用快速登记解决器(FireANTs)来调整表述(c). 第1阶段后的剩余错位大多在小腹器官中,第2阶段(d)后得到纠正.

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en:
Our two-stage pipeline is visualized in Figure 1 .
Stage 1 uses the images and their nonlinear representations. Stage 2 further uses segmentation losses for the optimization. Each stage is followed by a PET biomarker preserving post-processing step.
blocks.zh:
我们的两阶段管道在图1中可视化。
第一阶段使用图像及其非线性表示. 第2阶段进一步采用分割损失进行优化. 每个阶段之后都有一个PET生物标志保存加工后步骤。

blocks.en: Feature engineering. We extract a set of complementary representations from the input CT volumes that capture anatomy at different levels of granularity (Fig. 1 b). We first use anatomix [ 5 ] (using the publicly available anatomix-dev-vit weights) to extract a nonlinear 32-dimensional feature vector at each voxel. For visualization in Fig. 1b, we project these features onto their top three principal components. For better performance, we complement these learned features with MIND-SSC [ 8 ] , a hand-crafted descriptor based on local self-similarity that is likewise designed to be robust to cross-modal appearance variation. Finally, we obtain and use coarse semantic representations using pretrained segmentation networks: TotalSegmentator [ 25 ] provides anatomical labels from CT, while LION [ 19 ] provides PSMA lesion predictions from PET. Together, these learned, hand-crafted, and segmentation-derived representations provide complementary fine- and coarse-grained anatomical information for the registration stages below.
blocks.zh: 特色工程学. 我们从输入的CT卷中抽取一套补充表述,在不同的颗粒性水平上捕捉解剖(图1b). 我们首先使用解剖[5](使用公开的解剖-dev-vit重量)来提取一个非线性32维特性矢量在每个阴道上. 在图1b的可视化方面,我们将这些特性投射到其前三个主要部分。 为了更好的业绩,我们用MIND-SSC[8]来补充这些学到的特征,这是基于当地自我相似性的手动描述,其设计同样是为了有力地实现跨模式的外观变化。 最后,我们利用预先训练的分解网络获得并使用粗语义表达:TotalSectionator [25]提供CT的解剖标签,而LION [19]提供PSMA损伤预测. 这些经过学习、手工制作和分门别类的表述共同为下面的登记阶段提供了补充的粗细解剖信息。

We also add the LION lesion segmentation as a separate structure for both moving and fixed volumes, with a weight of 0.25 0.25 . To motivate each of the losses: • The generalized Dice loss [ 22 ] ℒ GenDice \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{GenDice}} does label matching while accounting for imbalance in size between large and small organs, while the one-sided Chamfer loss ℒ cham \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{cham}} is is the mean distance (capped at 20 mm), from each warped moving structure (with its soft shell) to the fixed structure. • We add a region-based loss that measures whether tissue inside each fixed organ maps into the corresponding moving organ. For each organ, we sample up to 4,000 fixed-organ points and map them through the current deformation; each mapped point has zero error if it lies inside the moving organ and is otherwise penalized by its distance to the organ in millimetres (again, capped at 20 mm). blocks.en: Figure 2: Constructing a recall-biased lesion mask . False negative PET lesion predictions would reduce PET biomarker preservation in our work and we therefore bias towards recall. Given the PET scan ( a ), we threshold it to find areas with high uptake ( b ) and subtract organs with non-pathological uptake ( c and d ) from this mask to arrive at a morphologically constructed mask ( e ). Finally, we add the segmentation prediction of a pretrained PSMA lesion segmentor ( f ) to the morphologically constructed mask to obtain the final recall-biased lesion mask ( g ).
blocks.zh: 图2 构建一个具有召回偏见的损伤面具。 假负 PET 损伤预测 将减少 PET 生物标记保存 在我们的工作, 因此我们偏向召回。 鉴于PET扫描(a),我们将其阈值以找到高吸收度区域(b),并从这个面具中减去非病理学吸收度(c和d)的器官,以形成一个形态构造的面具(e)。 最后,我们在形态构造的口罩中添加了预先训练的PSMA损伤分膜(f)的分膜预测,以获得最后的召回性损伤口罩(g ).

blocks.en: Volume preservation and PET biomarkers. Tumor burden may change biologically between the moving (follow-up) and fixed (baseline) scans, but the registration itself should not introduce additional changes in lesion volume. This is particularly important for PSMAReg, where the MTV (Metabolic Tumor Volume) and TLG (Total Lesion Glycolysis) biomarkers attain their ideal values when the deformation preserves the volume of ground-truth lesions. We therefore explicitly constrain local volume change within regions likely to contain tumor. Because these constraints can only preserve lesions included in their support, false-negative lesion predictions are particularly harmful to MTV and TLG, motivating a recall-biased lesion mask in the moving image.
blocks.zh: 体积保全和PET生物标记。 肿瘤负担可能在移动(后续)和固定(基线)扫描之间发生生物变化,但登记本身不应增加损伤体积的变化。 这对PSMAReg尤其重要,因为MTV(肿瘤体积)和TLG(总 Lesion Glycolysis)生物标记在变形保存地面真伪损害量时达到其理想值。 因此,我们明确限制可能含有肿瘤的区域的当地体积变化。 由于这些限制只能保留其支持中包含的损伤,虚假的阴性损伤预测对MTV和TLG特别有害,引发了感动图像中带有召回偏见的损伤面具.

blocks.en: While existing PSMA lesion segmentors such as LION [ 17 , 19 ] provide good lesion specificity, they may also miss lesions. To improve recall, we first threshold PET at SUV > 3 >3 . This thresholding also captures organs with high physiological tracer uptake, so we subtract masks for 16 such organs predicted from CT using TotalSegmentator, after dilating their union by 10 mm to account for within-timepoint PET/CT misalignment. Because SUV thresholding may still miss lesions with weaker uptake, we finally take the union of this region-constrained SUV mask with the moving-time-point LION prediction. The resulting mask M M therefore combines organ-filtered SUV thresholding with trained lesion segmentations to improve recall and is visualized in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: 虽然LION[17,19]等现有的PSMA伤痕分解器提供了良好的伤痕特异性,但也可能漏掉了伤痕. 为了提高召回率,我们在SUV > 3 > 3处设置了第一个阈值PET。 这种阈值还捕捉到具有高生理痕量吸收率的器官,因此我们用总分量(TotalSigmentator)将16个此类器官的口罩从CT中减去,然后将其结合放大10毫米,以说明PET/CT在时间范围内的错位. 因为SUV的阈值 可能仍然错过了损伤 吸收力较弱, 我们终于把这个 区域束缚的SUV的面具 与移动时间点的LION的预测结合起来。 因此,由此产生的面具M M将器官过滤的SUV阈值与训练有素的损伤分解结合起来,以提高记忆力,并在图2中可视化。

blocks.en:
Given the lesion mask M M , we encourage volume preservation during both registration stages using ℒ vol = ‖ M ∗ ( det ( Jac ⁡ ( ϕ ) ) − 1 ) ‖ 2 2 / ‖ M ‖ 1 \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{vol}}=\left\|M\ast\left(\det(\mathrm{Jac}(\phi))-1\right)\right\|_{2}^{2}/\|M\|_{1} as a regularizer [ 18 , 21 ] ,
which penalizes local volume change under the deformation ϕ \phi . To further drive down volume change after registration, we apply the volume-preserving post-processing of [ 7 ] , which drives the deformation to locally preserve volume via a local correction applied to ϕ \phi , obtained by solving a Poisson system with FFTs in < 0.5 <0.5 s on a GPU. However, applying this correction to all of M M can reduce anatomical alignment without improving biomarker preservation for regions of M M where volume is already preserved. We therefore modify [ 7 ] to post-process M M selectively, only when a lesion component is changing its volume above a threshold. For each connected component C i C_{i} of M M , let B i = | C i | B_{i}=|C_{i}| be its original voxel count and A i = | C i ∘ ϕ | A_{i}=|C_{i}\circ\phi| its count after warping. Components under the | log ⁡ ( ( A i + 1 ) / ( B i + 1 ) ) | ≤ 0.03 \left|\log((A_{i}+1)/(B_{i}+1))\right|\leq 0.03 threshold are considered adequately preserved by the warp and are not postprocessed. The rest receive up to four local volume correction passes, followed by eight component-wise passes that scale each lesion’s volume until its warped voxel count A i A_{i} approaches its original count B i B_{i} .

blocks.en: Background fold correction. Because the image-matching losses are evaluated only within the patient, the deformation is weakly constrained in the surrounding air outside the patient and can form anatomically meaningless folds in the displacement field. After stage 2, on the pairs from the training set that breach the %NDV threshold, 99.5 to 100% of folded voxels lie outside the body mask. We therefore repair folds (similar to [ 13 ] ) in the background outside the fixed-image body mask dilated with a 5 5 -mm safety margin. We do six passes of expanding the detected region by two voxels and replacing the deformation there with a feathered blend of the original and Gaussian-smoothed fields ( σ = 2.0 \sigma=2.0 voxels); the blending weight is zero within the protected body region.
blocks.zh: 背景折叠修正。 由于图像比对损失只在患者内部评估,变形在患者外的周围空气中受到微弱的制约,在迁移场中可以形成解剖无意义的折叠. 第2阶段结束后,在训练场的对子上,打破了%NDV阈值,99.5%至100%的折叠阴道位于身体罩外. 因此,我们在固定成像机身罩外的背景中修复折叠(类似于[13]),并放大5个5毫米安全系数。 我们通过6次将检测到的区域扩大为2个阴道,并用原始的和高斯吸积的球场的羽毛混合(==2.0\sigma=2.0 voxels);在保护体区域内的混合重量为零。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Parallelizing feature extraction and segmentation network passes . (a) Serially running all pretrained networks used in our framework at their default hyperparameters would exceed the 90 s limit. (b) We use an optimized schedule and vary the inference hyperparameters of each network to run networks in parallel and deliver segmentations before they are needed by Stage 2. (c) FP16 feature extraction and accumulation, plus the removal of a redundant segmentor, bring peak vRAM under the 80GB maximum defined by the challenge.
blocks.zh: 图3:平行的特征提取和分区网络通过。 (a) 以默认超参数连续运行我们框架内使用的所有预先训练过的网络将超过90个限度。 (b) 我们使用一个优化的时间表,并更改每个网络的推论超参数,以平行运行网络,并在第二阶段需要分解之前提供分解。 (c) FP16特性提取和积累,加上去除一个冗余分机,将峰值vRAM置于挑战确定的80GB最大值之下。

blocks.en: Maximizing throughput and utilization. The PSMAReg test phase requires each image pair to be registered in under ∼ 90 \sim 90 s on an 80 GB H100 GPU. Because our pipeline combines multiple feature extraction and segmentation models alongside registration solvers, a direct serial implementation would vastly exceed these constraints. We therefore optimize memory use, parallelize independent components, and selectively trade model resolution for speed, reducing the full pipeline from 83 GB and 812 s per pair to 72 GB and 79 s. In particular, we restrict computation to relevant image regions, run feature extraction and segmentation concurrently, use FP16 precision and gradient checkpointing where possible, remove overhead from library startup, file compression, and repeated CPU-to-GPU transfers and use faster, lower-quality segmentation models (e.g., TotalSegmentator’s 6-mm model) in stages where high-resolution predictions are unnecessary. The resulting execution schedule is shown in Figure 3 .
blocks.zh: 实现吞吐量和利用率最大化. PSMAReg测试阶段要求每个图像对在80 GB H100 GPU上在 ^ 90\sim 90 s 下注册. 因为我们的管道结合了多个特征提取和分解模型与登记解决器,直接的串行执行将大大超过这些限制. 因此,我们优化了内存使用,将独立的组件平行化,并有选择地进行贸易模型解析速度,将全管道从每对83GB和812s减少到72GB和79s. 特别是,我们把计算限制在相关的图像区域,同时运行特征提取和分区,尽可能使用FP16精度和梯度检查,从库启动中去掉间接费用,文件压缩,以及重复的CPU到GPU传输,并在不需要高分辨率预测的阶段使用更快,质量较低的分区模型(如TotalSector的6mm模型). 由此产生的执行时间表见图3。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Qualitative results . On randomly selected input pairs ( a ), our framework increases visual, label, and cross-modal agreement ( b , c , and d , respectively) across large deformations (rows 1 and 2), only failing in regions without topological correspondence (e.g., the arms in row 3).
blocks.zh: 图4:定性结果 在随机选择的输入对(a )上,我们的框架增加了视觉,标签和跨模式协议(分别为b,c,d),跨越大变形(第1和2行),只在没有地形对应的区域(如第3行中的臂)失败.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 实验

blocks.en: Dataset. We participate in the 2026 Learn2Reg PSMAReg Challenge. The pairs are longitudinal whole-body PSMA PET/CT scans that are downsampled by the challenge organizers to 192 × \times 192 × \times 288 at 2.7344 × \times 2.7344 × \times 3.27 mm resolution. The training set contains 202 image pairs, with TotalSegmentator annotations provided for the CT volumes and manual lesion annotations for the PET volumes. We do not train or fine-tune any pretrained models on this dataset; it is used only for hyperparameter optimization.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们参加了2026年的学习2Reg PSMAREG挑战赛. 配对为纵向全体PSMA PET/CT扫描,由挑战组织者进行下标,以2.7344×2.7344×3.27毫米分辨率为192××××××××××××288. 该培训集包含202个图像对,为CT卷提供了总分解说明,为PET卷提供了手动损伤说明。 我们不在此数据集上训练或微调任何预先训练过的模型;它只用于超参数优化。

blocks.en: Table 1: Performance of the top three methods on the test set of the challenge by rank, with rankings and evaluation provided by the challenge organizers. Standard deviations were not provided.
blocks.zh: 表1:挑战测试集中按级别划分的前三种方法的表现,由挑战组织者提供排名和评价. 没有提供标准偏差。

blocks.en: Evaluation. The challenge scores CT alignment by the DSC and HD95 of TotalSegmentator labels, and lesion alignment by the DSC and HD95 of manual PET lesion masks. It scores biomarker preservation by the MTV and TLG errors [ 14 ] , and regularity by %NDV [ 15 ] . The challenge ranks methods by a weighted geometric mean of Wilcoxon-based significance scores for registration accuracy (40%), PET biomarker preservation (40%) and field regularity (20%, with %NDV ≤ \leq 0.005% counted as equal).
blocks.zh: 评价。 挑战分数为DSC和HD95对TotalSigmentator标签的CT对齐,DSC和HD95对手动PET损伤口罩的损伤对齐. 它通过MTV和TLG错误评分生物标记保存[14],通过%NDV [15]评分规律. 挑战排序方法采用加权几何平均值,以Wilcoxon为基础的意义分数计算注册准确性(40%)、PET生物标记保存(40%)和实地规律性(20%,其中%NDV \leq 0.005%计算为相等)。

blocks.en: Results. Our framework ranks first on the PSMAReg challenge test set leaderboard as reported by the challenge organizers (Table 1 ). Sample alignments are illustrated for three randomly chosen subjects from the training set in Figure 4 .
blocks.zh: 结果。 我们的框架在挑战组织者报告的PSMAReg挑战测试板上排名第一(表1)。 图4所示培训中随机选择的三个科目的样本对齐。

blocks.en: Ablations. Table 2 validates the main components of our framework on 65 ground-truth pairs from 50 held-out training subjects. Tuning FireANTs substantially improves registration over its default hyperparameters, while adding anatomix and MIND-SSC features as input provides a large gain in anatomical accuracy and PET biomarker preservation. In all cases, volume regularization and projection progressively reduce MTV/TLG error with little loss in alignment accuracy. In Stage 2, segmentation-guidance improves organ alignment (particularly in the abdomen), while adding anatomix supervision back in prevents the degradation of unsupervised tissue alignment (as measured by increase in CT MAE) observed when optimizing with labels alone. We also find that running the entire pipeline without the anatomix and MIND-SSC features degrades performance.
blocks.zh: 诸障. 表2从50个被搁置的培训科目中验证了我们框架的65个地面事实对的主要组成部分。 培训FireANTs大大改善了其默认超参数的登记,同时增加了解剖学和MIND-SSC特性作为输入,在解剖精度和PET生物标记保存方面提供了巨大的收益。 在所有情况下,量的规范化和投影都逐渐减少MTV/TLG误差,对齐准确性几乎没有损失. 在第二阶段,分解指导可以改善器官的对齐(特别是在腹部),同时增加解剖监督,防止在优化标签时观察到的无监督组织对齐的降解(用CT MAE的增加来衡量)。 我们还发现,在没有解剖学和MIND-SSC特性的情况下运行整个管道会降低性能。

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Limitations and future work. We use a single diffeomorphic model to represent several motion models across the body. As a result, this model is underconstrained when fitting articulated (e.g., limbs) motion across time points. The model is simultaneously also overconstrained as it requires topological correspondence which is not always guaranteed. For example, when the arms are crossed in the baseline and are above the head and outside the field-of-view in the follow-up, diffeomorphic warps cannot fit this motion without topology changes [ 16 , 24 ] . Future work could use bone-specific [ 6 , 26 ] polyrigid models [ 1 ] to fit limb articulation.
blocks.zh: 限制和今后的工作。 我们用一个单双向模型来代表整个身体的几种运动模型. 因此,这种模型在装配跨时间点的伸展(如四肢)运动时受到不足的制约. 模型也同时受到过度限制,因为它需要地形通信,而这种通信并不总是得到保证。 例如,当武器在基线中被越过,并在头部上方以及在后续的视场外时,若不改变地形,二元化曲面就无法适应这一运动[16,24]. 未来工作可以使用骨质特异性[6,26]型聚硬化模型[1]来适应四肢伸缩.

blocks.en: Conclusions. Generalist models trained on large aggregated collections already exist for medical image registration [ 23 ] . However, to our knowledge, they generally have not yet exceeded the performance of custom models trained on the specific tasks. We instead jointly leverage the inductive biases of high-performing registration solvers with high-dimensional representations of images extracted by foundation models pretrained entirely on synthetic anatomy, and achieves the best test-set result despite never having trained on the challenge’s training set. We believe that hybrid approaches such as ours that combine networks pretrained on large collections of wildly variable synthetic data with high-quality solvers provide a scalable path for practitioners to align their datasets without needing to train networks for each new task.
blocks.zh: 结论。 已存在接受过大型汇总藏品培训的通用模型,用于医疗图像登记[23]. 然而,据我们所知,它们一般还没有超过受过具体任务培训的定制模式的绩效。 我们共同利用高性能的登记解析器的诱导性偏见,这些解析器对基础模型提取的图像进行高维度的表达,这些图像完全通过合成解剖学来进行预先培训,并取得了最佳的测试结果,尽管从未受过挑战培训。 我们认为,像我们这样的混合方法,将预先在大量收集的野生可变合成数据上训练的网络与高质量的解析器结合起来,为从业人员调整数据集提供了一个可扩展的路径,而无需为每项新任务培训网络。

blocks.en:
Agent usage. We used AI agents (Claude Fable 5.0 and GPT 5.6 Sol) extensively for software engineering, hyperparameter tuning, and PET/PSMA-specific literature search. For example, they implemented the throughput and utilization improvements enabling the package container to meet the time and resource constraints defined by the challenge. Further, the volume projection method used here [ 7 ] was found and implemented on the GPU by prompting them to search for and implement relevant published methods for post-processing based volume preservation in registration. We also used them to compile the list of organs with high physiological PSMA uptake when constructing the high-recall lesion mask.
As of August 2026, we did not yet find them suitable for suggesting specific technical directions in the registration methods themselves without considerable steering.
blocks.zh:
代理用户。 我们广泛使用AI代理(Claude Fable 5.0和GPT 5.6 Sol)进行软件工程,超参数调制,以及PET/PSMA特定文献搜索. 例如,它们实施了吞吐量和利用率的提高,使货包集装箱能够满足挑战所确定的时间和资源限制。 此外,在GPU上找到并实施了此处使用的量预测方法[7],促使它们搜索并执行相关的已公布的登记后处理量保存方法。 我们还利用它们汇编了在构建高召伤口罩时具有高生理PSMA吸收度的器官清单.
截至2026年8月,我们尚未发现它们适合在没有相当指导的情况下就登记方法本身提出具体的技术方向。

blocks.en: Implementation details. We clip the CT to [-1024, 1024] HU and the PET to [0, 15] SUV, and min-max normalize each. The body mask is the largest connected component of CT > -500 HU, with morphological hole filling and a closing. anatomix runs in 128³ windows with 25% overlap in FP16. Stage 1 uses at most 100, 100, 100 and 30 Adam iterations per level. Each level performs early stopping when the loss no longer decreases. LION [ 17 ] uses 6 of its 8 mirrored passes. TotalSegmentator [ 25 ] is used with its 6-mm, 3-mm and 1.5-mm models at a tile step of 0.8.
blocks.zh: 执行细节。 我们把CT剪辑到[1024,1024] HU和PET剪辑到[0,15] SUV,并且将每架Min-max正常化. 身体面具是CT中最大的连接组件 > -500HU,有形态孔填充和关闭。 anatomix在1283个窗口中运行,在FP16中重叠25%. 第1阶段每关最多使用100,100,100和30个亚当迭代. 每一级在损失不再减少时提前停止。 LION [17] 使用它的8个镜形通行证中的6个. 其6毫米、3毫米和1.5毫米的型号在0.8瓦的台阶下使用总分号[25]。
